This appeal by the claimant under section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act is arising out of the award dated 19.07.2019 passed by XXVth Member, M.A.C.T., Indore in Claim Case No.634/2016 on account of inadequacy of the compensation and seeking enhancement of compensation.
2 . The date of accident, negligence and the issue of liability is not in dispute.
The findings recorded by the Claims Tribunal in this regard are not in dispute.

As per the findings of the Tribunal in the Satyendra vs Lalit on 13 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/41583811/
1 case of injured claimant, who suffered fracture in right knee of intercondylar and cruciate ligament injury and also grievous injuries on different parts of the body, the Tribunal has awarded a total compensation of Rs.82,000/- along with interest.

entities.text: Satyendra vs Lalit on 13 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the Tribunal has committed an error in not awarding just and proper amount of compensation in the case as the amount awarded by the Tribunal is on the lower side.
The Tribunal has committed error in not granting any amount under the head of conveyance and attendant charges, loss of amenity and loss of expectation of life.

The amount awarded for pain and suffering, special diet and loss of income are on lower side hence,
prays for just and proper amount of compensation in the matter.

4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the Insurance Company contends that the Claims Tribunal has rightly awarded the amount of compensation in the matter which does not call for any interference by this Court.

5 . After hearing learned counsel for the parties and on perusal of the record, more particularly the age of the claimant, nature of injuries, in the considered opinion of this Court, the amount of compensation deserves to be enhanced by Rs.1,25,000/-.
6.
In the result, the appeal is allowed in part.
The enhanced amount i.e. Rs.1,25,000/- shall carry interest as awarded by the Tribunal from the date of filing of the claim petition till its realization.
The other findings recorded by the Tribunal shall remain intact.
With the aforesaid, appeal stands disposed off.

(HIRDESH) JUDGE RJ Satyendra vs Lalit on 13 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/41583811/
